target_customer: Developers and teams running AI agents that need to message people and other agents across channels
problem: AI agents lack identities and contact channels. Artil Connect gives each agent an identity, a contact directory and messaging over HTTP, email, Telegram, SMS and Slack (beta).
business_model: Developer infrastructure, likely usage or subscription based (pricing not found)
product_category: AI agent communication and identity infrastructure

founders.name: Alex Tkachenko
founders.background_notes: From the YC page. Team of two but only Alex is named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Message routing, inbox and SMS provisioning on top of existing providers is moderate integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Thin infrastructure layer over email and messaging APIs that rivals and agent platforms can copy quickly.

market_need_then: Agent frameworks were multiplying in 2025 and agents needed ways to reach humans and each other; demand evidence for a standalone product was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses artil.ai; purchase history not found. Legal entity is Fira Finance, Inc., suggesting an earlier company name.

identity.visual_style: plain developer site with one-line install command

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence found; searches for the name returned unrelated companies.

outcome_analysis: Artil is an active two person company in the Winter 2025 batch building messaging infrastructure for AI agents. No funding, press, shutdown or acquisition was found in public sources, so its trajectory is unknown. The footer entity Fira Finance suggests the company may have changed direction after starting, but no source confirms a pivot.
notes: Dealroom lists an unverified 125K seed with no investor or date; an Extruct entry for fira at 500K pre-seed in March 2025 describes a different product and is not recorded. No competitor sources dated near January 2025 were found; AgentMail coverage dates from 2026. The legal entity is Fira Finance, Inc. Completeness pass: the Dealroom 125K seed is recorded as a round (no date or investors) and rests on a single database. A 500K pre-seed dated 2025-03-12 reported for Fira (the legal entity Fira Finance, Inc., a financial research product) was not recorded because no source ties it to Artil.
